event.description: Use an eight-dimensional learned positional subspace without a learned projection
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 5,824 parameters at 99.900000%, a +0.900000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family. There is no accepted in-family result; the most recent failed result is attempt-0003, an optimization failure whose 4D learned-code/shared-projection representation plateaued at 11.45% internal validation with no checkpoint or official score. Hypothesis: the failure reflects either insufficient rank or the multiplicative bottleneck; an 8D learned position table embedded directly by zero-padding removes 280 parameters while doubling rank and eliminating the learned projection. This representational change is more informative than the nearest untested rank-6 factorization because it cleanly separates positional rank from projection optimization. Based on the prior accepted model's 96.90% validation versus attempt-0003's 4.95% at step 15,000, a fixed below-50% early-abort boundary limits compute on clearly stalled optimization without changing successful paths.
